signal_display_name: New Home Sales YoY contraction flag
threshold_note: threshold is rolling (window per lookback, in months); threshold_value is its latest value — see winner_trade_log.csv for the full threshold path
strategy_description: SPY exposure (0-100%) scales with the 9-month-lagged New Home Sales YoY contraction flag's position in its trailing LB36 min-max range (inverted). (Countercyclical orientation: weak/decelerating home sales = risk-on.)
lead_description: Signal lead = 9 month(s); registry floor L2 (Census publishes month M near the end of M+1)
notes: 20261016 rerun: tournament of 5500 strategy combos (+1 benchmark), 5344 IS-valid, floored lead grid [2, 3, 6, 9, 12]. Winner selected by in-sample Sharpe on the common IS window 2002-11-30..2018-01-31 (173 months) and evaluated on the held-out OOS window 2018-02-28..2026-05-31 (100 months): IS Sharpe 1.46 (B&H 0.79), OOS Sharpe 0.93 (B&H 0.89), OOS HAC t 3.26. Regime signals are IS-fit and forward-filtered. The previously published winner (hmm_stress/T2_roll_p25/LB60/P1_long_cash_pro/L0, OOS Sharpe 1.49) used full-sample smoothed HMM probabilities at L0; the same rule on the causal HMM scores 1.36 at L0 and 0.85 at L2 (hmm_lookahead_audit_20261016.json). Input: indicator transforms as published in signals_20260703.parquet. Gross of costs; 5 bps sensitivity in tournament_validation_20261016/. Lead-lag: Toda-Yamamoto Granger NHS->SPY significant at lags [11]; SPY->NHS significant at lags [1, 2].

selection.objective_formula: in-sample (common window [common_is_start, OOS start)) monthly mean/std*sqrt(12) of position_t*spy_ret_t; winner evaluated on the OOS window with ECON-T4 deployable scoring (fillna 0)

is_window.rule: eligibility before alignment: a candidate is IS-eligible only if its own first valid return leaves >= 60 IS months; common_is_start = latest first-valid-return date among eligible candidates; IS metrics for every candidate computed on [common_is_start, oos_start)
is_window.validity: IS window only: is_n >= 60, IS exposure in [0.05, 0.95] (P3: share of months long), IS std > 0, IS turnover < 24/yr; OOS never consulted

selection.rationale: Winner is the IS-valid row with the highest IN-SAMPLE Sharpe (common IS window) over the floored monthly grid L2..L12; OOS metrics are reported for that row only (no OOS look-ahead in selection). Regime signals (HMM, Markov-switching) are IS-fit and forward-filtered (scripts/_regime_causal.py).

legacy_oos_selected_row.note: OOS-argmax on this grid (pre-GH#251 rule), comparison only; see legacy_oos_selection_20261016.csv

sensitivity_own_is_start_row.note: IS argmax without common-start alignment; sensitivity only

previously_published.status: superseded: relied on full-sample, forward-backward smoothed HMM probabilities (look-ahead), a lead (L0) below the publication-lag floor, and selection by OOS Sharpe

inference.note: expected max |z| = Phi^-1(1 - 0.5/N) over N distinct position series (two-sided, independence approximation)
